definitions.gloss: encyclopedia; subject dictionary; reference work on topics
definitions.explanation: A reference work that provides detailed explanations of topics, concepts, and things (as opposed to a word dictionary). Organized by subject matter rather than by individual words.

examples.japanese: {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}で{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To look it up in an encyclopedia.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{料理|りょうり}{事典|じてん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an encyclopedia of Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: この{事典|じてん}には{世界|せかい}の{動物|どうぶつ}が{写真|しゃしん}つきで{詳|くわ}しく{紹介|しょうかい}されている。
examples.english: This encyclopedia provides detailed introductions to animals of the world with photographs.

notes:
Distinguished from {辞典|じてん} (word dictionary) by dealing with topics and things ({事|こと}) rather than words ({辞|じ}). Both are read じてん, so to disambiguate, {事典|じてん} is sometimes called 「ことてん」 and {辞典|じてん} is called 「ことばてん」.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}: encyclopedia
- ～{事典|じてん}: encyclopedia/dictionary of ~ (e.g., {料理|りょうり}{事典|じてん}, {音楽|おんがく}{事典|じてん})
- {事典|じてん}を{引|ひ}く: to look up in an encyclopedia

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {辞典|じてん}: dictionary — explains words and their meanings
- {辞書|じしょ}: dictionary — the most common everyday word for dictionary
- {字典|じてん}: character dictionary — explains individual kanji
- {図鑑|ずかん}: illustrated reference book — emphasizes visual identification

NOTE ON DISAMBIGUATION:
All three — {事典|じてん}, {辞典|じてん}, {字典|じてん} — are homophones (じてん). Context usually clarifies which is meant.
